title: Advances in research on receptor heterogeneity in breast cancer liver metastasis.
authors: Liu, Qinyu; Huang, Runze; Jin, Xin; Bai, Xuanci; Tang, Wei; Wang, Lu; Karako, Kenji; Zhu, Weiping
one_liner_zh: 该文综述乳腺癌肝转移中受体异质性，仅提及未来AI预测方向，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Breast cancer liver metastasis (BCLM) presents a critical challenge in breast cancer treatment and has substantial epidemiological and clinical significance. Receptor status is pivotal in managing both primary breast cancer and its liver metastases. Moreover, shifts in these statuses can have a profound impact on patient treatment strategies and prognoses. Research has indicated that there is significant heterogeneity in receptor status between primary breast cancer and liver metastases. This variation may be influenced by a multitude of factors, such as therapeutic pressure, inherent tumor heterogeneity, clonal evolution, and the unique microenvironment of the liver. Changes in the receptor status of BCLM are crucial for adjusting treatment strategies, and liver biopsy plays an important role in the treatment process. Directions for future research targeting changes in receptor status include in-depth study of molecular mechanisms, combined treatment strategies for receptor status reversal, development of artificial intelligence deep learning models to predict receptor status in liver metastases, and clinical research on new drug development and combination therapies. That research will provide more precise treatment strategies for patients with BCLM and improve their prognosis.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌肝转移（BCLM）在乳腺癌治疗中构成重大挑战，具有重要的流行病学和临床意义。受体状态在管理原发性乳腺癌及其肝转移中至关重要。此外，这些状态的变化可能对患者的治疗策略和预后产生深远影响。研究表明，原发性乳腺癌与肝转移之间的受体状态存在显著异质性。这种变异可能受多种因素影响，如治疗压力、肿瘤固有异质性、克隆演化以及肝脏独特的微环境。BCLM受体状态的变化对于调整治疗策略至关重要，肝活检在治疗过程中扮演重要角色。针对受体状态变化的未来研究方向包括深入探究分子机制、针对受体状态逆转的联合治疗策略、开发人工智能深度学习模型以预测肝转移中的受体状态，以及新药开发和联合疗法的临床研究。这些研究将为BCLM患者提供更精准的治疗策略，并改善其预后。
